title: Business System Analysis and Design: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
instructions: Answer question 1 (compulsory) and any other 2 questions.

parts.text: Differentiate between the following; i. System analysis and system Design ii. Waterfall model and RAD
Describe any three types of system maintenance.
Define the following terms; i. Modularity ii. Cohesion iii. Coupling
Define the term data flow diagram.
Describe the elements of a data flow diagram.
Describe the various techniques used in fact finding during system investigation.
Briefly explain five types of information systems and give examples of each type.
A company intends to replace its current MIS with a new one. Explain the different approaches for system changeovers the company can use.
Explain the incremental software development model and state its advantages in systems development.
What kind of knowledge and skills should systems analysts possess?
Describe the aim of testing and hence explain all the levels of testing in relation to levels of decomposition during the development of a system.
Define the term Feasibility Study. Describe at least four types of feasibility analyses.
